title: A Autopsy for the Inheritance
author: Sable Yarrow
blurb: Cyrus Montrose, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
